# e2b_lifecycle_events (Data Source)

Lists E2B sandbox lifecycle events. E2B exposes lifecycle events as read-only event history and does not expose an API to create events directly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "e2b_lifecycle_events" "recent" {
  sandbox_id = "sbx_123"
  types      = ["sandbox.started", "sandbox.paused"]
  limit      = 50
  order_asc  = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `limit` (Number) Optional maximum number of events to return.
- `offset` (Number) Optional pagination offset.
- `order_asc` (Boolean) Whether to sort events ascending by timestamp.
- `sandbox_id` (String) Optional sandbox ID. When omitted, E2B returns events across sandboxes visible to the configured team.
- `types` (Set of String) Optional lifecycle event type filters.

### Read-Only

- `events` (Attributes List) Lifecycle events returned by E2B. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--events))

<a id="nestedatt--events"></a>
### Nested Schema for `events`

Read-Only:

- `event_data_json` (String) Lifecycle event data encoded as JSON.
- `id` (String) Lifecycle event ID.
- `sandbox_build_id` (String) Sandbox build ID associated with the event.
- `sandbox_execution_id` (String) Sandbox execution ID associated with the event.
- `sandbox_id` (String) Sandbox ID associated with the event.
- `sandbox_team_id` (String) Team ID associated with the event.
- `sandbox_template_id` (String) Template ID associated with the event.
- `timestamp` (String) Lifecycle event timestamp.
- `type` (String) Lifecycle event type.
- `version` (String) Lifecycle event schema version.
